en: Guard
Hold on a moment. The road north is for trainers with all eight of Johto's Badges... and you have every one!
text: Stai puțin. Drumul spre nord e pentru antrenorii cu toate cele opt Insigne din Johto... și tu le ai pe toate!

en: Victory Road waits beyond the north door. Good luck up there.
text: Drumul Victoriei te așteaptă dincolo de ușa de nord. Mult noroc acolo sus.

en: Hold on a moment. The road north is for trainers with all eight of Johto's Badges, and you don't have them yet.
text: Stai puțin. Drumul spre nord e pentru antrenorii cu toate cele opt Insigne din Johto, iar tu nu le ai încă.

en: Come back once you've won the rest.
text: Revino după ce le câștigi pe celelalte.

en: Guard
Only a trainer with all eight of Johto's Badges may take the road north to Victory Road.
text: Doar un antrenor cu toate cele opt Insigne din Johto poate lua drumul spre nord, către Drumul Victoriei.

en: You've shown me all eight Badges. The way north to Victory Road is open to you.
text: Mi-ai arătat toate cele opt Insigne. Drumul spre nord, către Drumul Victoriei, îți este deschis.

en: Guard
Sorry, this door to Route 22 is closed. Kanto is open only to trainers who have stood before the League's Champion.
text: Îmi pare rău, ușa asta spre Ruta 22 e închisă. Kanto e deschis doar antrenorilor care au stat în fața Campionului Ligii.

en: You're the new Champion! Of course you may pass. Route 22 and Kanto are through this door.
text: Ești noul Campion! Bineînțeles că poți trece. Ruta 22 și Kanto sunt dincolo de ușa asta.

en: Guard
Through this door is Route 22, and Kanto beyond it. It opens to those who have stood before the Champion.
text: Dincolo de ușa asta e Ruta 22, iar mai departe Kanto. Se deschide pentru cei care au stat în fața Campionului.

en: Through this door is Route 22, and Kanto beyond it. Safe travels, Champion.
text: Dincolo de ușa asta e Ruta 22, iar mai departe Kanto. Drum bun, Campionule.

en: Guard
Sixteen Badges, Johto's and Kanto's... You're the trainer the League told me about. Mt. Silver is past this door.
The mountain is wild and its Pokémon are fierce. Go carefully.
Hold on! Past this door is Route 28, and Mt. Silver. Only a Champion with all sixteen of Johto's and Kanto's Badges may go there.
Guard
The road west leads to Mt. Silver. Only a Champion with all sixteen of Johto's and Kanto's Badges may go that way.
Mt. Silver is past this door. Not many trainers come back down it the same as they went up.
